mistral-le-chat: Mistral documents the move from Le Chat to Vibe. Merchant and publisher controls for Vibe are not documented by Mistral.
you-com: You.com documents its search API. Consumer search controls for brands are not documented by You.com.
duckduckgo-duck-ai: DuckDuckGo explains how Duck.ai selects web sources. Duck.ai-specific publisher and merchant controls are not documented by DuckDuckGo.
genspark: Genspark documents its workspace and assistants. Publisher controls for consumer answers are not documented by Genspark.
quark-ai: Quark describes its AI search and assistant. Crawler and merchant inclusion controls are not documented by Quark.
tencent-yuanbao: Tencent describes Yuanbao’s assistant. Publisher eligibility and citation reporting are not documented by Tencent.
kimi: Moonshot AI documents Kimi’s assistant and research tools. Publisher and shopping controls are not documented by Moonshot AI.
nano-ai-search: 360’s Nano search URL now leads to its workspace. Current publisher controls for consumer Nano AI Search are not documented by 360.
zhipu-qingyan: Zhipu documents its assistant. Brand or publisher controls for Qingyan answers are not documented by Zhipu.
gigachat: Sber describes GigaChat’s assistant. Publisher eligibility and brand measurement are not documented by Sber.
baidu-wenxin-assistant: Baidu’s reporting covers AI citations in regular Search. Equivalent reporting and controls for Wenxin Assistant are not documented by Baidu.
kakao-kanana: Kakao announced Kanana Search in KakaoTalk. Local listing and publisher eligibility for its answers are not documented by Kakao.
felo: Felo documents real-time search and footnotes. Publisher and merchant controls are not documented by Felo.
manus: Manus documents its general-purpose agent. Publisher or merchant participation in its research answers is not documented by Manus.
poe: Poe hosts different assistants with different capabilities. A common publisher or shopping programme for their answers is not documented by Poe.
apple-intelligence-siri: Apple documents Siri’s ChatGPT handoff. A Siri-specific route for publisher or merchant inclusion is not documented by Apple.
